bookkeeping_review.basis: Bookkeeping-only edits, proved mechanically: every changed Rust source is token-identical once comments and allow/expect lint attributes are removed, and every changed Cargo manifest differs only in package description and publication metadata. No executed value, seed, selection or decision changes.

package_input_review.basis: The embedded support status and missing-policy registry bytes are identical. The package now reads the status from its owning crate and ships a verified copy of the registry. The simulation, assertion, acceptance rule and retained observations are unchanged.

panel_prior_review.basis: Joint response uses its own design recipe. Its synthetic-rollout fixture explicitly sets Dirichlet concentration 10; the alpha < 1 proposal consumes no random value. Finite weights, Gaussian proposal, MH ratio and acceptance path are unchanged. The remaining joint recipes use other estimators.

synthetic_control_calibration_review.basis: Its measured construction (JointResponse, joint_design.regime_cohort_did) cannot select the changed single-unit Bayesian synthetic-control rows. Registry lookup partitions by query and estimator before projecting grid points. The joint-response calibration panel recipe fixes concentration ten. Its other recipes use different estimators. The new kernel requires a concentration below one half.
